name: Transplant-related Bronchiolitis Obliterans
aliases: Chronic Lung Allograft Dysfunction - Bronchiolitis Obliterans

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: International Society for Heart and Lung Transplantation (ISHLT) Bronchiolitis Obliterans Syndrome Criteria

criteria.description: Persistent decline in FEV1 of ≥20% from baseline post-transplant
Exclusion of acute infection or other causes of airflow obstruction
High-resolution CT showing air trapping and bronchial wall thickening
Transbronchial biopsy demonstrating submucosal fibrosis and luminal obliteration of small airways

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Persistent ≥20% decline in FEV1 from baseline with exclusion of infection and other causes of obstruction
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical supported by imaging and biopsy; histopathology may be limited by sampling error.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Air trapping on expiratory CT imaging
searchTerms: air trapped in lungs on exhale
lung air retention seen on CT

common.notes: Secondary to hypoxia and reduced lung function

occasional.notes: Detected on arterial blood gas or pulse oximetry

rare.symptomName: Weight loss due to chronic illness
rare.notes: Unintentional weight loss in advanced disease

rare.symptomName: Pulmonary hypertension secondary to chronic hypoxia
searchTerms: lung artery hypertension from low oxygen
pulmonary hypertension due to chronic hypoxia

laboratory: Exclusion of infectious pathogens via sputum and bronchoalveolar lavage cultures
Normal or mildly elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ESR)
imaging: High-resolution CT showing mosaic attenuation, air trapping, bronchial wall thickening
other: Spirometry showing irreversible obstructive pattern with FEV1 decline ≥20%
Transbronchial biopsy with submucosal fibrosis and obliteration of small airways

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of infectious agents on cultures

redFlags: Rapid decline in FEV1 despite treatment
Signs of pulmonary hypertension or right heart failure
references: Verleden GM, et al. Bronchiolitis obliterans syndrome: the Achilles’ heel of lung transplantation. Am J Transplant. 2018.
Weigt SS, et al. Bronchiolitis obliterans syndrome: pathogenesis and management. Clin Chest Med. 2017.
International Society for Heart and Lung Transplantation (ISHLT) Guidelines on BOS Diagnosis and Management.
